title: Basilica of San Francisco, La Paz
scope: The surviving carved-stone exterior of the basilica and its single bell tower at Plaza San Francisco in La Paz.
limitations: The modeled subject is the mapped church and single attached bell tower. The former convent, museum buildings and interiors are outside this model.
Carved iconography, side elevations and the precise belfry height are approximated using the dated photograph and architectural documentation.
